primary_source_receipts.access_scope: PUBLISHED TRANSCRIPT OF 2007 USC LAW SCHOOL COMMENCEMENT ADDRESS; lines 69-74
primary_source_receipts.finding: Munger says complex problems often become easier when turned around, gives a damage-and-avoidance example, and asks what will fail in life. Supports the method, not wealth inevitability or prevalence among rich people.

primary_source_receipts.access_scope: REVISED MUNGER TALK PUBLISHED WITH PERMISSION; background lines 20-32; social-proof lines 419-445
primary_source_receipts.finding: Munger describes social proof and recommends ignoring others when they are wrong. This supports a qualitative peer-influence mechanism, not prediction of a person's financial future from five friends.

primary_source_receipts.access_scope: BERKSHIRE HATHAWAY 2024 ANNUAL LETTER; PDF pages 13-14 performance table
primary_source_receipts.finding: Per-share market value compounded 19.9% annually in 1965-2024 versus 10.4% for the S&P 500 with dividends. Does not identify mistake avoidance as the sole cause or count shareholders made wealthy.

primary_source_receipts.access_scope: FEDERAL RESERVE NOVEMBER 2025 REPORT; PDF page 7, lines 257-289
primary_source_receipts.finding: Average interest was about 21.5% across all accounts and 22.8% for accounts assessed interest at end-2024; grace-period users do not incur finance charges. Supports the approximate 20% warning for revolving debt with qualification.

primary_source_receipts.access_scope: PRELEC AND SIMESTER ORIGINAL STUDY; PDF pages 1, 3, 5-6
primary_source_receipts.finding: Credit-card instructions increased willingness-to-pay in an uncertain-value auction, but the effect was not always present and overall payment-method effects in the second study were not uniformly significant. Does not directly prove the script's universal dopamine/loss-aversion mechanism.

Hardship distributions are taxable and not repaid to the account; an additional 10% tax can apply to early withdrawals, with exceptions. Supports 'might pay penalties and taxes', not a universal penalty.

calculation_receipts.method: Independent Python calculations: month-end annuity future values; early-contributor versus later-contributor endpoints and rate crossover; frozen lifetime-view-rate peer medians
calculation_receipts.assumptions: Nominal annual rate divided monthly; contributions at month-end; no taxes, fees, inflation, volatility or missed contributions; frozen views and age_days from VIDEO_MASTER.csv; first five listed peers are the PERFORMANCE_SENSITIVITY.csv cohort.
